description: Transfers (money sent or converted) on a profile, newest first, with both currencies, reference, status and recipient name. Filter by date (YYYY-MM-DD), status (e.g. outgoing_payment_sent, processing, cancelled) or search (reference/recipient). Default profile: personal.

profile.description: Profile id from list_profiles, "personal", "business" or part of the profile name

search.description: Case-insensitive match on reference or recipient name

since.description: Only transfers created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp)

until.description: Only transfers created on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp)

name: list_transfers

source.description: Amount converted, in the source currency (excludes the fee)

status.description: Wise transfer status, e.g. incoming_payment_waiting, outgoing_payment_sent, cancelled

title: List Wise transfers
